Provided further, notwithstanding anything

any person supplying information in confidence to
the Commission, or any part of such information

(y)  to  admit,  notwithstanding  any  of  the  provisions
of  the  Evidence  Ordinance  (Chapter  14),  any
information, whether written or oral, which might
be inadmissible in civil or criminal proceedings in
order to facilitate truth seeking;
(z)  to  make  an  application  to  a  Magistrate  having
jurisdiction, for the issuance of a search warrant,
to  enable  the  Police,  to  search  any  premises
suspected  to  contain  material  relevant  to  an
investigation being conducted by the Commission.
The provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure
Act, No. 15 of 1979 shall, mutatis mutandis apply
in such instances;
(za)  to  search  and  inspect  identified  premises  under
the  authority  of  a  search  warrant  issued  by  a
Magistrate, and examine, make copies of, extract
from, seize and retain, any object that is deemed
necessary  for  any  investigation being  conducted
by  the  Commission  and  to  ensure  that  any  such
site that may have been allegedly used for torture
or  illegal  places  of  detention  are  located  and
preserved. The provisions of the Code of Criminal
